verdict.rationale: Claude documents some user-side data controls: you can review and edit what memory saves and turn memory on or off, use incognito chats that are excluded from model improvement, and export your data from Settings > Privacy. The evidence never documents deleting conversations or accounts, retention periods, or retention settings. Missing for 10: documented deletion of chats or account data, configurable retention windows or stated retention periods, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion

citations.quote: how to review and edit what’s saved, and how to turn these features on or off
Your incognito chats are not used to improve Claude, even if you have enabled Model Improvement in your privacy settings.
Individual Claude users can export user information and chat history from Settings > Privacy
